---
name: Lesson feedback
about: Something is wrong, confusing, or outdated in an existing lesson or formula
title: "[Lesson] "

---

**Which lesson or formula?**
Path or link, e.g. `roadmaps/ai-engineer/lessons/prompt-injection.md`.

**What's wrong?**
Bad/dead video, wrong explanation, confusing section, broken link, factual error — be specific about what didn't click and why.

**What would fix it?**
If you have a suggestion (a better video, a clearer way to explain it, a correction), include it here.
